title: Academic writing 1: giving opinions
about: Collocations for giving and judging opinions in essays and reports: groundbreaking research, a powerful argument, provide evidence, irrefutable proof, a tentative explanation, carry out a study, acknowledge your sources.

parts.title: Stating things strongly and less strongly
Common mistakes
parts.note: Дві типові помилки з цієї рамки. Дослідження «роблять» з do або carry out, а не з make. Теорію «висувають» з put forward або propose, а не з give.

items.pattern: groundbreaking research / work / study (into / on sth) · research is uncountable: a groundbreaking study, a piece of groundbreaking research
items.meaning: research that discovers something completely new and changes how people understand a subject
items.example: In the 1960s, a young doctor carried out **groundbreaking research** into why some babies cry so much.
more: The university is proud of its **groundbreaking research** on healthy school meals.
Her **groundbreaking study** of village life in the 1930s is still read today.
items.watchOut: Research зазвичай незлічуване: groundbreaking research або a groundbreaking study, а не a groundbreaking research чи researches. «Проривне» — groundbreaking; breakthrough частіше буває іменником: make a breakthrough — зробити прорив.

items.pattern: make a significant / major / valuable contribution to sth / to doing sth
items.meaning: do something important that helps a subject, a project or a group to develop
items.example: Volunteers have **made a significant contribution to** keeping the town's parks clean.
more: Her report **makes a significant contribution to** the debate about traffic in the city centre.
Cheap trains **made a major contribution to** the growth of seaside holidays in Victorian Britain.
items.watchOut: «Зробити (внести) внесок» — make a contribution, зазвичай не bring, put чи give a contribution. Прийменник зазвичай to: a contribution to the debate, а не in чи into.

items.pattern: set out an argument / your reasons / your ideas · set it out · set – set – set
items.meaning: explain your ideas clearly and in a logical order, especially in writing
items.example: Our letter to the council **sets out** the **arguments** for a pedestrian crossing near the school.
more: Before the family meeting, Mum **set out her reasons** for selling the car.
The first chapter **sets out** the author's main **argument** in just a few pages.
items.watchOut: «Навести, викласти аргументи» — set out / put forward / present an argument; bring arguments звучить неприродно. Без додатка set out означає «вирушити в дорогу»: We set out at dawn.

items.pattern: a powerful / strong / convincing / persuasive argument (for / against sth) · be convinced by sb's argument
items.meaning: a reason, or set of reasons, that is very hard to disagree with
items.example: Nobody at the meeting could answer her **powerful argument** for keeping the swimming pool open.
more: The nurse made a **powerful argument** against selling energy drinks to children.
I wasn't keen on a camping holiday, but in the end I was **convinced by** my sister's **argument**.
items.watchOut: Argument має два значення: аргумент і сварка (We had an argument — ми посварилися). «Сильний, вагомий аргумент» — a powerful / strong argument, не a mighty чи heavy argument. «Переконаний аргументом» — convinced by an argument, не with.

items.pattern: shape our / people's thinking / views / ideas (about sth) · shape the way people think
items.meaning: have a strong influence on the way people think about something
items.example: The books we read as children often **shape our thinking** for the rest of our lives.
more: One awful package holiday **shaped my views** on big hotels for years.
Her television programmes **shaped the way** a whole generation **thought** about cooking.
items.watchOut: «Формувати мислення, погляди» — найчастіше shape thinking / views. Form краще залишити для form an opinion — скласти власну думку: I haven't formed an opinion yet. Make чи build our thinking не кажуть.

items.pattern: give / provide an (interesting / detailed / full) account of sth · an account of what happened
items.meaning: describe something, or say what happened
items.uk: розповісти про щось, описати; дати опис
items.example: The guide **gave** us **a lively account of** how the castle was built.
more: Her diary **gives a detailed account of** life in a mining village in the 1920s.
The report **gives a clear account of** how the money was spent.
items.watchOut: Account тут — розповідь, опис, а не рахунок у банку. «Розповісти, як усе було» — give an account of what happened, не tell an account і не make an account. Не плутай із take sth into account — враховувати.

items.pattern: provide / give / offer / present evidence (of / for sth / that…) · evidence is uncountable: a piece of evidence
items.meaning: give facts or information that show something is true
items.example: Your doctor's letter **provides evidence** that you were too ill to travel.
more: Can you **provide** any **evidence for** what you're saying, or is it just a feeling?
A good essay **provides evidence** for each point, not just opinions.
items.watchOut: Evidence незлічуване: some evidence, a piece of evidence, не an evidence і не evidences. «Наводити докази» — provide / give / present evidence; bring evidence в есе звучить неприродно. Evidence — дані, що свідчать на користь чогось; proof — доказ, що доводить остаточно.

items.pattern: support / back up a claim / a view / a theory · the claim that…
items.meaning: help to show that what someone says is true
items.example: There's no evidence to **support the claim** that carrots help you see in the dark.
more: The figures **support** the supermarket's **claim** that its prices haven't gone up.
Several studies **support the view** that pets are good for older people's health.
items.watchOut: Claim тут — твердження (те, що хтось стверджує), а не претензія чи скарга: скарга — a complaint. «Підтвердити твердження» — support / back up a claim. Prove a claim — довести остаточно, це сильніше.

items.pattern: a concise / brief / short summary (of sth) · give / offer / provide a summary
items.meaning: a short, clear description of the main points
items.example: The leaflet gives a **concise summary** of the new bus timetable.
more: Start your report with a **concise summary** of what you found.
Before the vote, the chair gave a **concise summary** of the arguments on both sides.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /kənˈsaɪs/, наголос на другому складі, у кінці «с», а не «з». «Лаконічний виклад» — a concise summary: laconic кажуть про людину чи відповідь, коротку аж до сухості. Résumé в американській англійській — це CV, а не стислий виклад.

items.pattern: strenuously defend / deny / oppose sth · formal; in speech: strongly
items.meaning: defend something with a lot of energy and determination
items.example: The head teacher **strenuously defended** the new rule on school uniforms.
more: The restaurant **strenuously denies** that it used frozen fish.
Local shopkeepers **strenuously opposed** the plan to close the high street to cars.
items.watchOut: Strenuously — дуже формальне слово для есе, звітів і новин. У розмові кажуть strongly: I strongly disagree. Не плутай зі strenuous exercise — важкі фізичні вправи.

items.pattern: come under attack / criticism / fire (from sb) (for sth)
items.meaning: start to be strongly criticised
items.uk: зазнати критики (нападок), опинитися під вогнем критики
items.example: The new parking charges at the hospital have **come under attack** from patients and visitors.
more: The diet **came under attack** from doctors for being too low in protein.
The film **came under** heavy **criticism** for making smoking look cool.
items.watchOut: «Зазнати критики» — come under attack / criticism, зазвичай не fall under attack і не get under criticism. Attack тут — не фізичний напад, а різка критика.

items.pattern: play a central / key / major / leading role in sth / in doing sth
items.meaning: be one of the most important people or things in an event or process
items.example: My aunt **played a central role** in organising the village festival.
more: Tourism **plays a central role** in the island's economy.
In many families, grandparents **play a central role** in bringing up the children.
items.watchOut: «Відігравати роль у чомусь» — play a role in sth, з прийменником in, не at і не to. Центральна роль — a central role: centre — іменник, a centre role не кажуть.

items.pattern: go into (great / more / too much) detail (about sth) · go into the details of sth
items.meaning: explain or describe something very fully, including small facts
items.example: The guidebook **goes into great detail** about where to eat in the old town.
more: The doctor didn't **go into detail**, but she said the results were fine.
I don't want to **go into** too much **detail**, but the wedding was a disaster.
items.watchOut: «Вдаватися в подробиці» — go into detail, зазвичай не enter into details і не go in details. Після go into зазвичай однина без артикля: go into detail; з артиклем — множина: go into the details of the plan.

items.pattern: establish / find / show a connection / link between X and Y · formal
items.meaning: show that two things are related
items.example: Scientists have **established a connection** between noise at night and high blood pressure.
more: The study failed to **establish a connection** between eating chocolate and spots.
Police have **established a link** between the two burglaries.
items.watchOut: «Встановити зв'язок» — establish a connection / link, не install і не set a connection: install — встановити програму чи пральну машину. Establish звучить формально; у розмові кажуть find a link.

items.pattern: irrefutable / conclusive / absolute proof (of sth / that…) · offer / provide irrefutable proof · formal
items.meaning: proof that is completely certain, so nobody can show it is wrong
items.example: The empty biscuit tin was **irrefutable proof** that the children had found my hiding place.
more: There's still no **irrefutable proof** that the diet works.
The old photo offered **irrefutable proof** that the house once had a second floor.
items.watchOut: Proof — доказ, що доводить остаточно; evidence — дані, що лише свідчать на користь чогось. У цьому значенні proof незлічуване: irrefutable proof, без a. Irrefutable — формальне слово; у розмові кажуть absolute proof.

items.pattern: a significant / clear / marked trend (in sth / towards sth / away from sth) · figures / statistics show a trend
items.meaning: a general change in one direction that is large or clear enough to matter
items.example: The figures show a **significant trend** towards people taking holidays closer to home.
more: There's been a **significant trend** away from eating red meat among young people.
Doctors have noticed a **significant trend** towards poorer eyesight among children.
items.watchOut: Trend — загальний напрямок змін у цифрах, моді, звичках: a trend towards smaller families. Tendency — схильність людини чи речі щось робити: He has a tendency to exaggerate. Обидва слова перекладаються «тенденція», але замінити одне одним зазвичай не можна.

items.pattern: the key / main / deciding factor in sth · a key factor in (doing) sth
items.meaning: the most important thing that causes or influences something
items.example: Location was the **key factor** when we chose our flat.
more: Good sleep was the **key factor** in her recovery.
Good public transport was a **key factor** in the town's growth.
items.watchOut: «Головний чинник» — the key / main factor; head factor не кажуть: head як прикметник уживають у назвах посад (head teacher, head chef). Прийменник частіше in: the key factor in his success.

items.pattern: a perfect / classic / typical example of sth / of how…
items.meaning: an example that shows a type of thing or behaviour extremely well
items.example: Our high street is a **perfect example** of how a small town can attract tourists without big hotels.
more: Yesterday's traffic jam was a **perfect example** of why we need a bypass.
This soup is a **perfect example** of what you can cook with just four ingredients.
items.watchOut: «Яскравий приклад» — a perfect / classic / striking example, не a bright example: bright — про світло й кольори. Приклад — example; sample — зразок (товару, крові, тканини). A shining example — теж правильно, але це взірець, приклад для наслідування, про щось хороше: She's a shining example to us all.

items.pattern: a clear / good illustration of sth · be / provide / give a clear illustration of sth
items.meaning: an example that shows clearly that something is true
items.example: The packed trains every morning are a **clear illustration** of the need for more services.
more: The queue outside the new bakery is a **clear illustration** of how much people missed fresh bread.
Her story provides a **clear illustration** of how hard it is to find a flat in the city.
items.watchOut: Illustration — не лише малюнок у книжці, а й приклад, що доводить думку: a clear illustration of the problem. «Наочний приклад» — a clear illustration / example, не a transparent illustration.

items.pattern: a tentative explanation / conclusion / suggestion · offer / give a tentative explanation (of / for sth)
items.meaning: an explanation given by someone who is not completely sure it is right
items.example: Researchers have offered a **tentative explanation** for why some people hardly ever catch colds.
more: The plumber gave a **tentative explanation** for the damp patch, but said he'd need to lift the floor to be sure.
Her **tentative conclusion** is that children sleep better in cooler bedrooms.
items.watchOut: Tentative — непевний, попередній, обережний: так в есе показують, що думка не остаточна. У розмові частіше кажуть a possible explanation. Не плутай з temporary — тимчасовий.

items.pattern: broadly support / agree with / reflect sth · broadly speaking · broadly similar
items.meaning: support something in a general way, though not in every detail
items.example: The survey results **broadly support** the view that people want more cycle lanes.
more: I **broadly agree** with what you said, but not with all the details.
Most parents **broadly support** the idea of a longer lunch break.
items.watchOut: Broadly тут — «загалом, у цілому», а не «широко». «Широко підтримують» (багато людей) — widely supported: The idea is widely supported.

items.pattern: there is a strong tendency (for sb) to do sth · have a strong tendency to do sth · a growing / general tendency
items.meaning: something that often happens, or that someone often does
items.example: There is a **strong tendency** for tourists to stay in the old town and never see the rest of the city.
more: My brother has a **strong tendency** to leave everything until the last minute.
Among teenagers there's a **strong tendency** to skip breakfast.
items.watchOut: Tendency (to do sth) — схильність щось робити; trend — загальний напрямок змін. Тому a strong tendency to exaggerate, а не a strong trend to exaggerate. Після tendency зазвичай to + дієслово: a tendency to forget.

items.pattern: gather / collect evidence / data / information (on / about sth)
items.meaning: find facts or information and bring them together
items.example: Before the meeting, parents **gathered evidence** about speeding cars outside the school.
more: The insurance company is still **gathering evidence** about the cause of the fire.
We spent a month **gathering information** on the cheapest ways to heat the house.
items.watchOut: «Збирати докази» — gather / collect evidence, не pick evidence: pick — збирати ягоди, гриби, квіти. Evidence незлічуване: gather evidence, не gather evidences.

items.pattern: carry out / conduct a (detailed) study (of / into sth) · carry out a survey / an experiment
items.meaning: do a careful piece of work to find out about a subject
items.example: The council **carried out a detailed study** of how people travel to the city centre.
more: A local charity **carried out a study** into how often older people feel lonely.
Before building the playground, they **carried out a survey** of local families.
items.watchOut: Українське «проводити» має різні відповідники: дослідження — carry out / conduct a study, збори — hold a meeting, час — spend time. Hold a study і spend a study не кажуть. Study тут — дослідження, а не навчання.

items.pattern: play a (big / small / important) part in sth / in doing sth
items.meaning: be one of the causes of something, or help it to happen
items.example: The weather **played a part** in our decision to stay at home.
more: Diet and exercise both **play a part** in how well you sleep.
Everyone in the family **played a part** in getting the house ready for the party.
items.watchOut: Play a part in sth — бути однією з причин, впливати. Take part in sth — брати участь. Порівняй: Money played a part in it (гроші теж зіграли роль), але I took part in the race (я брав участь у забігу).

items.pattern: supporting evidence (for sth) · offer / provide / find supporting evidence · evidence to support sth
items.meaning: facts or information that help to show something is true
items.example: Your claim that the bus is always late won't be taken seriously without **supporting evidence**.
more: The essay makes some good points, but it needs more **supporting evidence**.
If you want a refund, bring the receipt and any **supporting evidence**, such as photos of the damage.
items.watchOut: «Докази на підтвердження» — supporting evidence, не persuading чи proving evidence. Supporting — від support (підтримувати, підтверджувати).

items.pattern: challenge a theory / a view / a claim / an idea
items.meaning: say or show that a theory may be wrong
items.example: Her book **challenges the theory** that children need to start school at four.
more: A new study **challenges the** popular **view** that fat is always bad for you.
Few people dared to **challenge** the old **idea** that girls aren't good at maths.
items.watchOut: Challenge a theory — поставити теорію під сумнів, а не «кинути виклик» у спортивному сенсі. Challenge sb to sth — викликати когось на змагання: He challenged me to a game of chess.

items.pattern: acknowledge your / its sources · acknowledge sb's work / help · formal
items.meaning: say clearly where you got your information or ideas from
items.example: If you quote from a newspaper in your essay, remember to **acknowledge your sources**.
more: The article about our town's history doesn't **acknowledge its sources**, so I'm not sure I trust it.
At the start of her cookbook, she **acknowledges** her grandmother, who taught her many of the recipes.
items.watchOut: «Вказувати джерела» — acknowledge / cite your sources, не recognise чи admit your sources. Вимова: /əkˈnɒlɪdʒ/, як у knowledge, а не «акноулідж». Слово формальне, для письма.

items.pattern: commit plagiarism · be accused of / guilty of plagiarism · plagiarise sth (AmE plagiarize)
items.meaning: use someone else's words or ideas and pretend they are your own
items.example: The student was found to have **committed plagiarism** after copying her essay from a magazine.
more: Even copying one paragraph without saying where it came from can mean you've **committed plagiarism**.
The singer was accused of **plagiarism** when fans noticed his tune was the same as an old folk song.
items.watchOut: «Вчинити плагіат» — commit plagiarism (як і commit a crime) або просто plagiarise; не make plagiarism і не do plagiarism. Вимова: /ˈpleɪdʒərɪzəm/, перший склад «плей».

items.pattern: do / carry out / conduct research (into / on sth) · research is uncountable: some research, a piece of research · original research
items.meaning: study a subject carefully to find out new facts
items.example: My cousin is **doing research** on how music helps older people remember things.
more: The council **carried out research** into why people don't use the new car park.
I always **do some research** before I buy anything expensive.
items.watchOut: «Робити (проводити) дослідження» — do / carry out research, не make research. Research незлічуване: some research, a piece of research або a study, а не a research і не researches.

items.pattern: put forward / propose / develop a theory (that…) · put sth forward · put forward an idea / a plan · formal: advance a theory
items.meaning: suggest a theory or idea so that people can discuss it
items.example: A local historian has **put forward a theory** about why the old bridge was built so far from the village.
more: Some doctors have **proposed a theory** that cold showers help you wake up.
Nobody took my idea seriously when I first **put** it **forward**.
items.watchOut: «Висунути теорію» — put forward / propose a theory, не give a theory і не move forward a theory. Put forward так само працює з idea, plan, suggestion: She put forward a plan to save money.

warmup.uk: Мій друг проводить дослідження старих мостів нашого міста.
warmup.q: My friend is ___ research into the old bridges in our town.
warmup.explain: Проводити дослідження — do або carry out research, не make і не hold.

warmup.uk: Мій дід висунув власну теорію, чому зникли бджоли.
warmup.q: My grandad has ___ his own theory about why the bees disappeared.
warmup.explain: Висунути теорію — put forward або propose a theory. Give a theory не кажуть.

warmup.uk: Наша бібліотека робить вагомий внесок у життя району.
warmup.q: Our library ___ a significant contribution to life in the area.
warmup.explain: Зробити (внести) внесок — make a contribution to sth, не bring і не put.

warmup.uk: У нас немає доказів, що це зробив сусід.
warmup.q: We have no ___ that the neighbour did it.
warmup.explain: Докази — evidence, без -s: це незлічуване слово. Proves — дієслово «доводить».

warmup.uk: Ця історія — яскравий приклад того, чому варто читати договір перед підписанням.
warmup.q: This story is a ___ example of why you should read a contract before you sign it.
warmup.explain: Яскравий приклад — a perfect / classic / striking example, не bright.

warmup.uk: Ці цифри загалом підтверджують те, що сказав нам лікар.
warmup.q: These figures ___ support what the doctor told us.
warmup.explain: Broadly — загалом. Widely — широко, серед багатьох людей; wildly — шалено.

warmup.uk: У мого сина сильна схильність перебільшувати.
warmup.q: My son has a strong ___ to exaggerate.
warmup.explain: Схильність людини — tendency. Trend — загальна тенденція в цифрах чи моді. Habit кажуть з of + -ing: a habit of exaggerating.

warmup.uk: Свіже повітря теж відіграло роль у її одужанні.
warmup.q: Fresh air also ___ a part in her recovery.
warmup.explain: Відігравати роль — play a part. Take part — брати участь.

A.q: The ban on dogs in the park has ___ under attack from dog owners.
The study tried to ___ a connection between sugar and bad behaviour in children.
A.explain: Встановити зв'язок — establish a connection. Install — встановити програму чи техніку.

A.q: Please write a ___ summary of your holiday plans for the group: three sentences at most.
A.explain: Стислий виклад — a concise summary (або brief, short).

B.q: My uncle is a ___ example of how it's never too late to learn to swim.
B.explain: Яскравий приклад — a perfect example, не bright.

B.q: Most of the neighbours ___ agree with the plan for the new park, though some want more benches.
B.explain: Broadly agree — загалом погоджуватися. Widely — серед багатьох людей: widely known.

B.q: Fresh ingredients are the ___ factor in good cooking.

C.q: Music ___ a big part in my grandad's life.
C.explain: Play a part — відігравати роль. Take part — брати участь.

C.q: A good writer ___ the people whose ideas she has used.
C.explain: Acknowledge — зазначити чийсь внесок чи джерело. Admit і confess — зізнатися в чомусь поганому.

C.q: The police are still ___ evidence at the scene of the accident.
C.explain: Збирати докази — gather або collect evidence. Pick — збирати ягоди чи квіти.

M.q: I need to ___ some research before I write my essay on tourism.
M.explain: Do research або carry out research, не make research.

M.q: The scientist who first ___ this theory was laughed at.
M.explain: Теорію висувають: propose або put forward a theory. Give a theory не кажуть.

M.q: Have you done any ___ on the history of the village?
M.explain: Research незлічуване: any research, some research, без -s і без a.

practice.q: His ___ research on road safety led to the first speed bumps outside schools.
The hospital is famous for its groundbreaking ___ into heart disease.
The new bakery has ___ a significant contribution to village life.
Her book makes a significant ___ to our understanding of how children learn to read.
Street markets make a significant contribution ___ the life of a city.
In the opening paragraph of your essay, ___ out your argument clearly.
The report sets ___ three arguments for opening the library on Sundays.
Lower bills are a ___ argument for insulating your loft.
My parents didn't want a dog, but in the end they were convinced ___ my argument that it would get us all walking more.
Grandad made a powerful ___ for keeping the old orchard instead of building garages.
The way our parents talk about money often ___ our thinking about it for life.
That one trip to India shaped my ___ about travel forever.
In her letter, Gran ___ a funny account of her first day at school in 1955.
Her new book gives a moving ___ of her years as a nurse in a children's hospital.
The landlord asked us to ___ evidence that we had paid the rent on time.
The photos are clear ___ that the fence was already broken when we moved in.
Nothing in the report ___ the claim that the new bus lane has made traffic worse.
The new tests support the company's ___ that its yoghurt contains no added sugar.
The back cover gives a ___ summary of the story without giving away the ending.
Could you send me a ___ summary of the meeting? Just the main points, please.
The mayor ___ defended the plan to build a car park on the old football pitch, despite angry protests.

example.title: The school uniform report
example.uk:
Минулого семестру клас нашої доньки провів детальне дослідження шкільної форми. Спочатку діти зібрали дані серед учнів, батьків і вчителів, а потім написали звіт.

У звіті вони виклали аргументи обох сторін. Для більшості батьків ключовим чинником була вартість. Опитування загалом підтвердило думку, що форма допомагає сім'ям заощаджувати гроші, але не показало жодних суттєвих тенденцій в оцінках учнів.

Діти також поставили під сумнів теорію, що у формі всі поводяться краще, і запропонували попереднє пояснення того, чому деякі учні її ненавидять: вона незручна. Наприкінці вони вказали свої джерела. Директорка сказала, що цей звіт — чудовий приклад того, як учні можуть відігравати роль в ухваленні шкільних рішень.
example.en:
Last term, our daughter's class [[carried out a detailed study|c3]] of school uniforms. First they [[gathered evidence|c2]] from pupils, parents and teachers, and then they wrote a report.

In the report, they [[set out the arguments|a3]] on both sides. Cost was the [[key factor|b1]] for most parents. The survey [[broadly supported|b5]] the view that uniforms save families money, but it didn't show any [[significant trends|a16]] in pupils' marks.

The children also [[challenged the theory|c6]] that uniforms make everyone behave better, and they offered a [[tentative explanation|b4]] of why some pupils hate them: they're uncomfortable. At the end, they [[acknowledged their sources|c7]]. The head teacher said the report was a [[perfect example|b2]] of how pupils can [[play a part|c4]] in school decisions.
